g.text: ✔ first check baselines silently; a 304 costs nothing; new inbox files are mail, other changes are not
✔ wait polls until mail lands and exits 0 (the exit is the wake); --max-min gives up with exit 3
✔ transient errors back off and are recorded (redacted); rate limits wait for the reset
✔ 401 and 404 are fatal (exit 4), not an endless quiet loop
✔ more mail than --max-mail is queued for the next run, never dropped
✔ a rewritten history (old head gone) re-baselines instead of failing
✔ the feed gets one JSON line per mail, marked untrusted
✔ mail is sanitised: escapes, controls, bidi and zero-width characters go; token shapes are redacted; long mail is cut
✔ token: --token-file, then GH_TOKEN, then GITHUB_TOKEN, then `gh auth token` with windowsHide; never printed
✔ usage: --repo is required and must be OWNER/NAME; --help exits 0; status prints the state
✔ config file: repo and options in camelCase, flags win
✔ post: writes inbox/<UTC stamp>-<lane>.md, commits only that file, pushes only with --push
✔ post refuses secrets (types only, never the value), oversize reports, bad lane names and non-clones
✔ --api-base: https only, plain http only for localhost, no credentials in the URL
✔ end to end: wait against the local GitHub stub with real fetch wakes on a new inbox file
